lines.t: In the noise, the pulse still calls…
A whisper in rhythm… The Spirit moves…
Blessed are the broken who call out in the dark,
Truth on their breath, fire in their hearts.
The city hums, yet the silence speaks,
The Spirit dwells where the seeker seeks.
Call upon His name — in the light, in the flame!
Let the sound be real, let the pulse remain.
Blessed are the souls that run to Him,
Refuge rising where the beat begins.
Shadows twist, neon bleeds red,
But mercy writes what fear once said.
In the echo, faith grows loud,
The Son delivers through the crowd.
Lift me higher, through the chaos and the wire,
I find Your shelter, wild yet pure desire.
Spirit spinning circles through my veins,
Freedom beating, truth remains.
Call upon His name — in the light, in the flame!
Blessed are the ones who rise again.
The rhythm bows, the heart obeys,
Delivered souls in the endless praise.
The Spirit within, alive through the sound…
Blessed are those who love The Son…
Delivered. Found.
